description: For your own product: the Free check, and once claim_domain and verify_claim proved it is yours, an Audit Drive or a Payment proof. For anyone: a Tool comparison or a data plan. Prices and limits: https://agentdrives.com/pricing.json. At the card checkout VAT comes on top of the price; paid over HTTP 402, the price includes any VAT. free, the Free check ($0): what an agent sees of your product; private; one per domain every 90 days. audit, an Audit Drive ($499): our agent signs up like a new customer (send no access) and checks every documented API route, MCP tool and CLI command against your docs; a security review; your fix list within 48 hours; a new drive after your fixes within the Audit year (followup_drive). When the drives find an agent uses the product fully with no person (L5), it ends in a certificate. target (1 to 5) is your goal, never a promise. renewal, the Audit Drive renewal ($199 a year), from 11 months after your audit. proof, a Payment proof (at cost, see processor). One real purchase in your checkout with your discount code. When it goes through, your listing shows Pays on its own for 90 days. Send pay kind code and authorise: true. stack3 or stack, a Tool comparison ($490 for 3 tools, $650 for 5): send urls and use_case. builder, a data plan ($49 a month: follow any number of products, a signed webhook), or team ($290 a month: that and every listing in one file, GET /api/export). A paid order needs business: true (we sell to businesses only). It answers payment.url, the card checkout, and payment.agent, to pay over HTTP 402 with no person (pay_order). The same order again while it waits for payment returns that order (reused). Paid over HTTP 402, a data plan runs one month and doesn't renew by itself: pay again before it ends and the next month follows on. We email you 3 days before it ends. Ordering accepts the terms (https://agentdrives.com/legal/terms). An error comes with its fix.

access.description: A Tool comparison or a Payment proof: a login, key or coupon our agent may use past a sign-up wall. Not on an Audit Drive or its renewal (400 access_not_needed: we sign up ourselves; if your plans are paid, give a discount code with pay)

authorise.description: With pay kind code, required: true is your go-ahead, "Our agent may buy and cancel my paid plan with this code." (else 400 authorise_required)

business.description: Optional: true when you buy for your business. Anyone can buy (https://agentdrives.com/legal/terms#business). Stripe's checkout asks the billing address, and a business name and VAT ID for the invoice when you buy for a business

buyer.description: Optional, for an order paid over HTTP 402 (pay_order): your business on our invoice. An EU VAT ID that VIES confirms gets the invoice at once, and outside the Netherlands no VAT.

address.description: Postal address for the invoice, one line

country.description: Two-letter code of your business's country, e.g. US

vat_id.description: EU VAT ID with its country prefix, e.g. DE123456789

code.description: Optional: a promotion code of ours. Its discount comes off this order, at the card checkout and over HTTP 402 (400 invalid_code when it is unknown, expired or used up)

email.description: An agent's own account, a Tool comparison or a data plan: the address for the receipt and our mails about the order (the comparison ready, the plan's end). Optional

idempotency_key.description: Optional: any unique value, e.g. a UUID. Sending the order again with the same one returns the order it made, never a second one (24 hours); the same one with other fields is refused (idempotency_key_reused)

listed.description: false: the drive stays private, never in the directory

no_offers.description: Paid orders: true and we send you no offers for our other products

note.description: Optional: anything our agent should know

offers_ok.description: free: true only if you want the monthly agent access report and offers

pay.description: Optional on an Audit Drive, required on a Payment proof (proof): let our agent buy your plan at your own checkout. kind code: your discount code (value) that leaves $0.50 a purchase (on an Audit Drive it works for every drive until 365 days after the report, its purchase inside the price; on a Payment proof our card pays it at cost); send authorise: true with it; sandbox: a login to your checkout's test mode or sandbox (value), for the free checkout test only (an Audit Drive answers 400 access_not_needed: we sign up ourselves); seat: no value, we email you the address our agent signed up with, you upgrade it. Sealed, never shown back.

value.description: code: 6 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores; sandbox: the login (up to 2,000 characters)

plan.description: The Audit only: your paid plan. The drive buys it, uses one paid feature, cancels it and asks for the refund your product's own way. choice include: at cost as its own line on this order, the unused part refunded after the drive; self_refund: you refund the drive's purchase, at most $50 a month (above it: plan_needs_person, choose include or write to us); none. name and price_cents (a month, US cents; whoami's claims[].plan_hint suggests one). Above $50 a month add confirm: true; above $500 by arrangement

processor.description: With pay kind code: your checkout. card: Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Shopify or another checkout, your code leaves $0.50 and a Payment proof costs $0.87; paddle: Paddle, your code leaves $0.70 and a Payment proof costs $1.09. Default card

product.description: free: Free check · audit: Audit Drive · renewal: Audit Drive renewal · proof: Payment proof · stack3/stack: Tool comparison · builder/team: data plan

target.description: audit or renewal: the level you aim for. It is your goal, shown on your dashboard, never a promise: the level is the one the drives find

tool.description: Your product's directory slug, if listed

urls.description: Tool comparison: the tools to drive

use_case.description: Tool comparison: what your agents should do with them

waiver.description: Paid orders: true is the buyer's tick on "Start right away. I lose my 14-day right to cancel once it's delivered." (https://agentdrives.com/legal/terms#withdrawal); without it, Stripe's checkout asks it before payment

name: order

next_free_at.description: when the domain's next free check opens
